mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO weather_today_cache ( region_id, temp, sky, pty, wind, tomorrow_high, tomorrow_low, tomorrow_sky, tomorrow_rain, day2_high, day2_low, day2_sky, day2_rain, day3_high, day3_low, day3_sky, day3_rain, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{temp}, #{sky}, #{pty}, #{wind}, #{tomorrowHigh}, #{tomorrowLow}, #{tomorrowSky}, #{tomorrowRain}, #{day2High}, #{day2Low}, #{day2Sky}, #{day2Rain}, #{day3High}, #{day3Low}, #{day3Sky}, #{day3Rain}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE temp = VALUES(temp), sky = VALUES(sky), pty = VALUES(pty), wind = VALUES(wind),
tomorrow_high = VALUES(tomorrow_high), tomorrow_low = VALUES(tomorrow_low), tomorrow_sky = VALUES(tomorrow_sky), tomorrow_rain = VALUES(tomorrow_rain),
day2_high = VALUES(day2_high), day2_low = VALUES(day2_low), day2_sky = VALUES(day2_sky), day2_rain = VALUES(day2_rain),
day3_high = VALUES(day3_high), day3_low = VALUES(day3_low), day3_sky = VALUES(day3_sky), day3_rain = VALUES(day3_rain),
updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT region_id AS regionId, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_today_cache WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
SELECT region_id AS regionId, temp, sky, pty, wind, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM weather_today_cache
